concept.title: Test runs
concept.shortdesc: A test run is one execution campaign: run your test cases and record the results.

ol.li: Click New test run — name it (e.g. "Design verification — rev B"), add a description, and optionally pin it to a baseline. A project owner can still delete that baseline later: the run keeps the reference as part of its record, and the run's card shows Baseline deleted for it.

Every run is a card under Test runs, with its status chip, a bar of its pass, fail and blocked results against the project's test cases, and how many are still to go. A run in progress also appears beside the sections as the active test run, with Continue run; its card has Complete and Abort.

Open the run from its card. Every test-case artifact in the project gets a row with:
Ref and Test case — the test case's reference and title.
Verified by — automated, or manual (human) / physical test tagged in purple, since agents may not run those.
Verifies — the requirements the test case verifies.
Status — pass, fail, blocked, or not-run, picked from a chip.
Notes — free text, edited inline.
Version tested — which version of the test case the result was recorded against.
Evidence — the capture the result rests on (see below).
Executed at — timestamp of the recorded result.
Record results as you execute. Each change saves immediately.
Complete run when finished (or Abort run). Completed and aborted runs become read-only.

section.title: Recording on a phone
section.p: On a phone the run lists its test cases, each with its reference, what it verifies, its method and its result. Record results (or tapping a test case) opens the recorder, one test case at a time: the test case's procedure, four large Pass, Fail, Blocked and Not run buttons, Notes and measured values, and Attach evidence. Record and next saves the result and moves on; the arrow goes back one. A test case you leave untouched is skipped, not recorded. On a completed or aborted run the recorder steps through the results without changing them.
The latest recorded result per test case is what feeds the coverage rollup and the result chips in the Matrix view.
Agents can also record test results — with proposal write mode those arrive as proposals for approval first.
